_meta.purpose: Single table of Amazon marketplaces: domain, currency, content languages. Language depends on the country; some marketplaces are multi-language and then the language of each listing must be chosen explicitly.
_meta.status: Carried from general knowledge and the original specs, NOT verified against the seller's account. Which languages a given account/category may actually use is shown in Seller Central and in the feed template (VERIFY_IN_UI). Add or correct entries here, then run tools/sync_shared.py.

US.note: Amazon.com also serves Spanish-language shoppers; Spanish content availability is VERIFY_IN_UI.

CA.note: English and French content; choose per listing.

BE.note: French and Dutch; choose per listing.

AE.note: English and Arabic; choose per listing.

SA.note: Arabic and English; choose per listing.

EG.note: Arabic and English; choose per listing.

IN.note: English is the usual listing language; Hindi availability is VERIFY_IN_UI.
